investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Eval Failing: POST /api/agents Returns 409 Agent Quota Exceeded (limit is 100)
investigation.summary: The AURA observability eval for remote-agent-create (and all sibling checks remote-agent-state and remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-15T23:14:52Z because POST /api/agents returned HTTP 409 with the swarm error "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". The agent creation call was rejected before any agent was provisioned, so zero required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected and all contract assertions went unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The production-api swarm backend rejected the eval's POST /api/agents request with a 409 Conflict because the org used by the observability probe has reached its remote agent quota of 100. Because the creation call failed immediately, the runner (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, line 1312: createAgent) never received an agent identity or VM assignment, leaving all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) absent and causing the eval to fail. This is an eval-infrastructure failure against the production API; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence to confirm a broader user-facing outage.

investigation.title: image-generation-stream Eval Failure: SESSION_OPEN_FAILED 404 on Agent Runtime Harness Endpoint (production-api)
investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed immediately with a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error carrying HTTP 404, indicating the agent runtime harness endpoint targeted by the eval runner was unreachable at the time of the run. Because the stream never progressed past generation_start, neither required evidence key (frameTypes, imageUrlPresent) was collected, causing the expected-output contract to fail completely.
investigation.rootCause: The eval runner (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, line 1411) issued an SSE request to /api/generate/image/stream, which internally attempted to open a session against the agent runtime harness. The harness returned HTTP 404, surfaced as SESSION_OPEN_FAILED in the generation_error frame. This terminated the stream before any generation_completed frame or image URL could be emitted, leaving both required evidence keys (frameTypes, imageUrlPresent) absent. The failure is localized to the agent runtime harness reachability within the production-api runtime environment; it is an eval infrastructure failure against that endpoint and not a confirmed user-facing production outage, as no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence. The check is registered as required=false with statusImpact=informational for this runtime environment.

The agent creation call was rejected before any agent was provisioned, so zero required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected and all contract assertions went unmet.
investigations.rootCause: The production-api swarm backend rejected the eval's POST /api/agents request with a 409 Conflict because the org used by the observability probe has reached its remote agent quota of 100. Because the creation call failed immediately, the runner (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, line 1312: createAgent) never received an agent identity or VM assignment, leaving all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) absent and causing the eval to fail. This is an eval-infrastructure failure against the production API; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence to confirm a broader user-facing outage.
